column4: ゴアの町、そこにレイが攻め込んでいた
column5: In the town of Goa, Lei is attacking.

column4: 抗戦する事も出来ずに町の人は降参状態
column5: The townspeople are in a state of surrender, unable to resist.

column4: （ゴアは自由都市連合に加盟していないので守ってもらえない）
column5: (Goa is not a member of the Free Cities Alliance, so they are not defended.)

column4: （第９条で無防備都市宣言をしている）
column5: (They declared the city an undefended city under Article 9.)

column4: 他の住民はビクビクして怯えてばかり
column5: Other residents are living in fear and trembling.

column4: 誰か俺と勝負しろと一般人に喧嘩をふっかけているとか・・
column5: Apparently someone is provoking ordinary people, challenging them to fights saying 'Who wants to battle me?'

column4: ここでメアリーとの出会い１（内容未定）
column5: Here, the first meeting with Mary (content undecided).

column4: みんな怯えて喧嘩相手に誰も出ないのでメアリーが出るとか
column5: Everyone is scared and no one steps up to fight, so Mary steps in.

column4: レイを恐れてみんな逃げ惑い、それに巻き込まれて倒れたメアリー、気まぐれで助け起こすレイとか
column5: Everyone panicked and fled in fear of Lei, and Mary, caught up in it, collapsed; Lei whimsically helped her up.
